chapter: Countess Johnson's band and the Kansas City scene
title: Her brother Roy Johnson, pianist and later Hampton's bassist
summary: Roy Johnson played piano in Kansas City and later bass with Lionel Hampton.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah, well, she was very, very powerful. And then, going on from that, she's got a brother that plays piano now, that was a bass player with Lionel Hampton.
Where does he play and work now?
*Both the Rust and Bruyninckx discographies indicate Holiday recorded in September, 1938 with a Margaret "Queenie" Johnson in New York.
He's in Kansas City playing piano.
And when we left there, he was playing piano, like she was. But after I left there, next time I saw him, he was playing bass with Lionel Hampton.
I thought so. He was in there when Hamp (phonetic) had some of his better bands, after the original band, you know.
